items.text: kal hi paisa de dunga
haan ji
do din mein
theek hai
sadak par milna
wind chill
ji kal

items.context: Kya aap promise karte hain ki kal tak payment hoga?
items.text: haan thik hai
do baje ke baad
Mein agle hafte tak pura payment kar dunga
Paise to jaldi bhej dunga kal tak hi
Apko aaj ya kal tak valloan ka paisa mil jayega
Mujhe is hafte ke end tak payment karna padega
Aaj se do din baad tak paisa transfer kar dunga
Kal tak poora amount bhejne ki koshish karunga
Thoda waqt de do agle mahine tak paisa jama kar dunga
Kal tak paisa bhejne ka pura vada karta hoon

items.context: Kya aap payment date confirm kar sakte hain?
items.text: Thoda hafta aur de do payment ka samay

items.context: Kab aapke payment ka promise hai?
items.text: Aaj se 5 din mein paisa transfer kar dunga

items.context: Kab tak payment karne ka plan hai?
items.text: Agli tareekh 15 July ko poora paisa bhej dunga
Kal subah bank transfer karke bhej dunga
Mujhe thoda samay chahiye tha is mahine ke kharche ke wajah se agle mahine ke 10 tak complete amount bhijwa dunga
Aap thoda ruk jaiye mujhe apné account se paisa transfer karna tha kal tak pura payment kar dunga
Main apne ghar ke financial situation dekh ke aapko pakka 20th August tak pura payment kar dunga

items.context: Aap paisa kab tak de sakte hain?
items.text: Main thoda busy tha is mahine ke kharche jyada hone ke karan pura paisa 5 din baad de dunga

items.context: Kab tak paise dene ka vada karte hain?
items.text: Mujhe thoda intazaar karna hoga kyunki mere paas thoda paise abhi nahi hain, 15 August tak zarur payment kar doonga

items.context: Aapko kab tak payment karna possible hoga?
items.text: Kya aap mujhe thoda aur waqt de sakte hain? 22nd July tak main poora paisa jama kar ke bhej dunga

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: promise_to_pay - replies to a payment reminder with a date or amount they will pay
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
